notes.title: Breaking the Ice
notes.content:
Hello World!!

I’m pleased to announce "Call to Strike":
[i]a top-down helicopter-based shooter where you take on daring missions to strike, rescue, refuel, and upgrade your arsenal to overcome the odds and complete your objectives![/i]

My name is Chris van Zyl, Lead Developer and Project Leader for “Call to Strike”. The game has been in development for about 2 years, and we’re finally at a stage where we can start sharing our progress with you! 

"Call to Strike" is a nostalgic nod to the 90s, a time of great consoles like the Sega Genesis (also known as Mega Drive) and SNES. It's inspired by twin-stick shooters such as the Strike series, Air Strike Patrol, MIA: Missing in Action, and others. Growing up, I spent countless hours immersed in these games, always hoping that the genre would persist. Now, I hope that "Call to Strike" can serve as the continuation I've longed for. Whether you're a 90s kid yearning for a trip down memory lane, or a newcomer eager to explore something from the past, reimagined for the present, I invite you to join me on this journey. I’ll post regular updates on the games development here and look forward to your feedback. 

We are working on a game demo and will share more information about it in the coming months. 

Make sure to check out [url=www.calltostrike.com]calltostrike.com[/url] for additional info. 

I’m excited to share more updates with you!

Cheers
